one_line: Hold the box to the lens with a one-line invitation, show the contents, end on a pick-one question.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a girl about 10 holds the kit box to the lens, smiling, box front facing us. Said (transcript) and subtitled word by word: "בואו נכין צמידים". 0:02 she sits at a table with the open kit: "מה קיבלנו פה?"
q1_hook.why: The product is held up and handled in the first frame (S1, H3), a face speaks at once (H4, F6), and the invitation is said and subtitled together (H6, T3). The box front is large and readable as a cover (H7). It states an action but no benefit (H2).

beats.what: Girl holds the kit box to the lens: "בואו נכין צמידים"
beats.why: Product and invitation in one frame

beats.what: Seated at a table with the open kit; she gestures over the beads and threads: "מה קיבלנו פה?"
beats.why: Shows what is inside, named piece by piece

beats.what: To camera under a hand-drawn sun and flower overlay: "בואו נכין צמידים"
beats.why: The invitation returns as a turn into making

beats.what: Top-down, her hands work a gold chain; the doodle overlay stays
beats.why: A glimpse of making, not the whole process

beats.what: Close-ups of a forearm in a gold charm bracelet with candy-machine charms, then her smile
Close-up of a wrist in a letter-bead bracelet and a charm bracelet
She stands against a white wall: "איזה צמיד הכי אהבתם?"
beats.why: A pick-one question ends the Reel

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Spoken and subtitled at 0:22 to 0:24: "איזה צמיד הכי אהבתם?". The caption adds no ask.
q2_flow.why: Product first, then contents, then the finished result held back to 0:14 is a simple reveal order, with a mid-Reel restatement at 0:10 (R4, R3). A new view every 2 to 5 s keeps it moving (E2). The pick-one question needs the viewer to have looked at the bracelets, which they have (R6, C5).

q3_cta.what: Said and subtitled at 0:22 to 0:24: "איזה צמיד הכי אהבתם?" (transcript: "איזה שמיד אחיה"). Caption: "בשיתוף @palphot" and a preview line, no ask. No link, price or where to buy.
q3_cta.why: One CTA, said and shown after the bracelets, answerable at once (C1, C6, R6). It is a pick-one question, not an open one, and nothing says where to buy (C5). The subtitle sits in the lower band (T4).

q4_shown.what: The box held to the lens at 0:00; the open kit's trays of beads, charms and threads at 0:02; her hands working a chain at 0:12; then close-ups of two finished bracelets worn at 0:14 to 0:22. No price. The making is not shown.
q4_shown.why: The contents and the finished, worn result are shown close, with a kid vouching (S6, F4). How hard it is to make stays unanswered because the making is barely shown, which no principle in the list covers. A child's face is on camera throughout (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 8 shots in 25 s (first pass), about 3 s each, jump cuts between talk, table and wrist close-ups. A hand-drawn sun, rainbow and flower overlay at 0:10 to 0:14. Torn-paper subtitles, word by word. Ends on a white-framed transition effect.
q5_edit.why: A change every 2 to 5 s with jump cuts suits a short Reel (E2, R3). Colourful subtitles follow her speech (E4, T1), and the doodle overlay is a playful extra that crowds the table shot for 4 s (T2). It stops right after the question (E8).

q6_topic.what: A girl opens a bracelet-making kit, shows what is inside and the finished bracelets; it serves girls and parents looking for a craft or gift idea.
q6_topic.why: A cheerful first-look unboxing with a happy peak at the finished bracelets (K1, K8). It names no parent worry, occasion or milestone (K6, K7), and the kit's price and age are not said.

q7_filmed.what: Phone propped at about eye level, static, in a plain room with a white wall and a black sofa; a wooden table; a high angle on the open kit; handheld close-ups of a wrist; a wide standing shot at the end. Even indoor light.
q7_filmed.why: A propped phone, direct address and a plain home room look native (F6, H8, F7). The box front is large at 0:00 and the bracelet close-ups fill the frame (F4). In the closing wide shot the bracelets are tiny, and subtitles sit over her legs (F4, F2).

q8_text.on_screen: Colourful torn-paper subtitles, word by word, centred low, about 78% down the frame: 0:00 "בואו נכין צמידים", 0:04 "קיבלנו פה צארמים", 0:08 "ואפילו צבעונים וחוטים", 0:10 "בואו נכין צמידים" under a doodle overlay, 0:22 "איזה צמיד הכי אהבתם?". No other headline or price.
q8_text.caption: "קבלו הצצה לערכת הצמידים המהממת של make it real". About 13 words: a preview line, then "בשיתוף @palphot". No hashtags, no CTA.
q8_text.why: Word-by-word subtitles match speech and work muted (T1, E4), but the torn-paper type is small and low, near the buttons (T4, T5). The caption names product and brand and opens the partnership in its last line, visible in a short caption (T7, T8, S7).

weak_points: The making barely shown; no price or where to buy; the child's face on camera throughout; low torn-paper subtitles; the doodle overlay hides the table shot; a closing question with a one-word answer.
lumebook_takeaway: Hold a LumeBook book to the lens with one invitation line, flip through it hands only, and end on a pick-one question about two covers.
not_verified: Whether the girl owns the account or who filmed it; her exact age; music (not established); the price and where to buy; the subtitles are quoted from frames, and the first transcript line ("נחיל") mishears "נכין". Cut count from the first pass.
